# Refactor: Move metadata reconciliation to pre-push and doctor only

## Context

The PR adds `ReconcileDisconnectedMetadataBranch()` to fix a bug where local and remote `entire/checkpoints/v1` branches become disconnected (no common ancestor). Currently, reconciliation is called eagerly from 3 read paths via `EnsureMetadataReconciled()`. This is too aggressive — reconciliation should only happen at well-defined fix points, not on every checkpoint read.

**New approach:** Only reconcile in pre-push (before tree merge) and `entire doctor`. All other read paths just detect + warn, pointing users to `entire doctor`.

## Changes
